set.body: From review of S5.6. DesktopEffects RequestAdmission calls backend.admission(dataset) without the content, so the c == content guard (AdmissionLedger.scala:233) only compares the app's own digest with its echo. A real backend that re-reads its stored spec could answer for content eyes4s never saw. The protocol should carry the digest, and the backend should refuse a mismatch with a typed error. Do this after protocol 1.4 (ready-batch) lands.
set.title: S5.6 follow-up: admission request carries the verified content digest
